item.text: {"issues":[{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Playback can stop, crash, or fail to continue, often after switching apps; one example instead reports a missing podcast option.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["79169d41-d899-4681-a789-b7ba03862d2e"],"issue_id":"TMP_PLAYBACK_07_A","issue_name":"Playback stops or crashes"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Users report that requested songs are replaced by other tracks, alongside separate complaints about slow switching and low audio quality.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["1c800418-31b5-4a50-becb-8664d70c0120","b836e1ab-8e78-4b09-8617-44389b31d41b"],"issue_id":"TMP_PLAYBACK_07_B","issue_name":"Requested songs do not play"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"no","description":"Users report difficulty downloading or playing music offline, mixed with access expectations, download speed, and family account limitations.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["ea626d17-40da-443b-8c41-f3e4873b6a5e"],"issue_id":"TMP_DOWNLOADS_01+TMP_DOWNLOADS_02_A","issue_name":"Offline access and downloads"},{"actionable":"yes","coherent":"yes","description":"Downloaded tracks may disappear, fail to play offline, or repeatedly require downloading again.","heterogeneous_review_ids":[],"issue_id":"TMP_DOWNLOADS_01+TMP_DOWNLOADS_02_B","issue_name":"Downloaded tracks disappear or fail offline"},{"actionable":"no","coherent":"no","description":"Most examples express general dislike or advise against downloading the app, while one specifically says downloads fail.","heterogeneous_review_ids":["c686b540-a499-4b62-8c11-fe327da2a76c","e27020f4-f1a9-4430-b660-886e1f15442b","e82df55d-abbd-4f27-b404-4ffab8a46a49","1ea2ad1b-57b2-42e1-bfc0-b2870a71fe67","c729a090-6521-4049-841b-1c4eb0bef011","6715b818-9ee1-4ec9-bb68-1d91e682a2fc","edfb421a-ff54-43d1-80b0-713619483f55","c0a13c91-512a-46cb-9fc9-dbbe09f27853"],"issue_id":"TMP_DOWNLOADS_03_A","issue_name":"Vague download complaints"}] }
